SELECT a.id, a.adjust_no, a.target, a.effective_time, a.status, a.reason, a.flow_instance_id, a.approve_time, a.effect_time, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_time, u.nickname AS create_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_price_adjust_item i WHERE i.adjust_id = a.id) AS item_count FROM scm_price_adjust a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.create_by
(a.adjust_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.status = #{status} AND a.target = #{target}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_price_adjust_scheme x WHERE x.adjust_id = a.id AND x.scheme_id = #{schemeId})
ORDER BY a.id DESC
SELECT a.*, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM scm_price_adjust a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.create_by WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.retail_price AS hq_retail_price FROM scm_price_adjust_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.adjust_id = #{adjustId} ORDER BY i.id
SELECT status FROM scm_price_adjust WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
